name: Rye
overview: Scripture references rye as a small grain cultivated in both Egypt and Canaan, highlighting its agricultural significance in biblical times. It was commonly used alongside wheat and barley, especially in bread-making, as seen in Ezekiel's instruction to mix various grains including rye to sustain oneself. The careful sowing of rye in its proper place, as described in Isaiah, underscores the ordered provision God designed for His people.
